CONFIDENCE COMES FROM EVIDENCE

When a drawing is unclear,
keep the question visible.

A scanned P&ID is more than a collection of lines. The AI workflow keeps source locations, confidence, and agent evidence attached to every element.

Local inference is the default. A cloud model requires your consent for each job. If a tag is unreadable, it stays unreadable until a person resolves it.

  1. 01

    Inspect the source

    Compare denoising before and after. Flag any removed diagram content.

  2. 02

    Review the uncertain

    Accept, edit, reject, or add elements over the original page.

  3. 03

    Build with traceability

    Export CAD plus the graph and tag index. Independent CAD QA remains a release gate.

A FEW GOOD QUESTIONS

Before you
get drawing.

What do I need to run LineaForge?

The source beta targets Windows with Python 3.12 or later. Install the pinned requirements and launch the PySide6 desktop app. The download includes setup instructions and build scripts; a signed installer is not yet distributed.

Does PDF to DWG preserve everything?

Vector PDFs offer the best editable geometry. Font substitution, clipping, complex fills, and unusual source structures can affect fidelity. Scans need tracing or the P&ID review workflow. Inspect every output before using it in engineering work.

Why do DWG files need another converter?

DWG is handled through a separately installed ODA File Converter or LibreDWG, or licensed local CAD through the MCP backend. DXF is available offline through ezdxf. Each external tool has its own license and installation requirements.

Can it digitize scanned P&IDs accurately?

The workflow is designed to extract symbols, text, and connectivity with source evidence, but it needs a real vision model and human review. Unreadable tags are flagged, never guessed. Dense diagrams and unfamiliar symbols can still fail. No production accuracy claim is made for this beta.

Are my drawings sent to a cloud service?

Core conversion and PDF tools run locally. P&ID mode defaults to a local model endpoint. Cloud inference is blocked until you explicitly enable consent for that job, and transmitted artifacts are logged. This website demo never uploads drawing files.

Does it support 3D or isometric drawings?

LineaForge focuses on 2D drawings. It does not reconstruct 3D models or interpret isometric piping as a 3D system.
